name: Enchiridion
description: Installs enchiridion — the Notion knowledge-base mirror CLI — from the private iyaki/enchiridion GitHub Releases (authenticated download).

github_token.description: GitHub token with contents:read on iyaki/enchiridion (the repository is private). Reads ${localEnv:GITHUB_TOKEN} when empty.

version.description: enchiridion release version to install (for example: 0.1.0). Use 'latest' for the newest release.

enchiridion_home.description: Cache root for the mirrored knowledge base. Leave empty for the default ~/.local/share/enchiridion.
